name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-07-04.41.2) introduced by West Australian Senator [Dorinda Cox](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/dorinda_cox) (Greens), which means it succeeded. ### Motion text > *That the Truth and Justice Commission Bill 2024 be referred to the Joint Standing Committee on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Affairs [for inquiry and report by 11 February 2025](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Joint/Aboriginal_and_Torres_Strait_Islander_Affairs/TruthandJusticeBill24).*
